description: State of the repository when Phase 0 began, measured on the development machine. Assessed scores are from the analysis brief (A4); they are estimates, not gate results.

environment.database: PGlite 0.5.8 (PostgreSQL in WASM) over a local socket. Docker Desktop would not start, and no PostgreSQL server binary is installed. PGlite serialises every connection through one session, so it is sound for migrations, the SQL validator and unit tests, and unsound for the concurrent API traffic the e2e suites create.
environment.api: Started against PGlite; became unstable under e2e load (pool timeouts, protocol errors).

backend_typecheck.note: strict mode was off (strict, noImplicitAny, strictNullChecks all false)

backend_unit_tests_without_db.note: all 29 failures are ECONNREFUSED: the tests need a database

backend_unit_tests_with_pglite.note: vitest exited non-zero on 50 unhandled PGlite protocol errors ('unexpected parseComplete'), an artefact of the single-session database, not of the code

partial_pglite_run.others: failed with database pool timeouts or 'Connection terminated' from the single-session database; not attributable to the application

e2e.authoritative_source: CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml, job 'Migrations, SQL and API') against PostgreSQL 16

npm_audit.backend: 3 (1 moderate, 2 critical) in vitest, dev only
npm_audit.frontend: 4 (3 moderate, 1 high) in vite (dev server) and react-router
